arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show tracking image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: tracking_algorithm
arg.description: Tracking algorithm -1: the newest one of this OpenCV (VitTrack, NanoTrack or DaSiamRPN), 0: DaSiamRPN, 1: NanoTrack (OpenCV 4.7 or later), 2: VitTrack (OpenCV 4.9 or later)

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: dasiamrpn_model
arg.description: dasiamrpn_model.onnx of DaSiamRPN, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default

arg.name: dasiamrpn_kernel_cls1
arg.description: dasiamrpn_kernel_cls1.onnx of DaSiamRPN, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default

arg.name: dasiamrpn_kernel_r1
arg.description: dasiamrpn_kernel_r1.onnx of DaSiamRPN, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default

arg.name: nanotrack_backbone
arg.description: Backbone model (onnx) of NanoTrack, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default (NanoTrack v2)

arg.name: nanotrack_neckhead
arg.description: Neck and head model (onnx) of NanoTrack, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default (NanoTrack v2)

arg.name: vittrack_model
arg.description: Model (onnx) of VitTrack, a path or URL (downloaded to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time), empty for the default (object_tracking_vittrack_2023sep.onnx of opencv_zoo)
